question: What is established above the power principle in the śiva principle?
premises: Above that is the śiva principle.
There, in the four directions, beings are established.
They include the all-pervading, sky-natured Ananta Lord and those who share in his power.
inference: The śiva principle is arranged with Ananta, the sky-natured all-pervading Lord, and his associated powers stationed in the four directions.
uncertainties: The compound may imply Ananta together with distinct directional lords who partake of his power.
plain_english: Above that is the śiva principle. There, established in the four directions, are the all-pervading, sky-natured Lord Ananta and those who share in his power.
